claims.text: In a 2024 lab test, the Aero One lasted 22 hours.

evidence.excerpt: In a controlled test on 12 November 2024, an Aero One prototype played video continuously for 22 hours with display brightness set to 150 nits.

claims.explanation: The source establishes the product, year, test setting, and duration. The repair restores the prototype, workload, and brightness conditions.
claims.repair: In a November 2024 lab test, an Aero One prototype played video for 22 hours at 150 nits.

claims.text: The Aero One delivers all-day battery life in every situation.

evidence.excerpt: The test did not measure gaming, calls, camera use, or standby time.

claims.explanation: One controlled video-playback result does not establish battery life for every workload or condition.

claims.text: A reviewer called it ‘the best battery we've tested.’

evidence.excerpt: The Aero One has among the longest-lasting batteries we've tested this year.

claims.explanation: The checked quotation says ‘among the longest-lasting,’ not ‘the best,’ and limits the comparison to the current year.
claims.repair: A reviewer placed it among the longest-lasting batteries they had tested that year.

claims.text: Unit sales rose from 10,000 to 20,000 units after launch.

evidence.excerpt: Unit sales increased from 10,000 in the quarter before launch to 20,000 in the quarter after launch.

claims.explanation: The exact values and before/after direction match the supplied report.

claims.text: The battery drove the sales growth.

evidence.excerpt: A regional marketing campaign ran during the post-launch quarter. We did not measure the separate effects of the campaign and product features.
evidence.locator: S3: Quarterly report, second and third sentences

claims.explanation: The source records timing and a concurrent campaign but no causal measurement. The battery's effect cannot be isolated from this evidence.
claims.repair: The checked evidence does not establish what caused the increase.

limitations: This is a fictional package example. Only the three supplied source passages were used; no external research was performed.
revised_text: In a November 2024 lab test, an Aero One prototype played video for 22 hours at 150 nits. A reviewer placed it among the longest-lasting batteries they had tested that year. Unit sales rose from 10,000 to 20,000 after launch; the checked evidence does not establish what caused the increase.
